item.description:

They expect shared buffers and readiness-based I/O, fundamentally incompatible with compio's completion-based model that requires owned buffers. We need an adapter that: Works with compio's owned-buffer async I/O Presents synchronous Read/Write traits to tungstenite Efficiently bridges sync and async world Challenge with Tungstenite Tungstenite is the de-facto Rust WebSocket protocol implementation.

item.title: DESI's Dizzying Results
item.description:
